_note: Hand-labelled key moment per clip (frame index, 0-149), read from media/final/keyframes/sheet_<seq>.jpg (every 3rd frame, held-out camera 0), so labels are +-2 frames. Definition: the decisive instant of the action (release of a throw, contact of a swing, placing of a box). status: proposed -> confirmed once checked by Faizan.

basketball.event: white player releases the pass (ball leaves the hands between frames 51 and 54)

boxes.event: box set down on the stack (arms lower onto the stack, frames 60-66); low confidence, the held-out view is from behind

football.event: white player releases the throw (arm fully extended, ball leaving)

juggle.event: continuous juggling, no single key moment; left out of the key-frame error

softball.event: contact zone of the full swing (bat horizontal across the body, frames 129-135)

tennis.event: contact of the big forehand (racket fully forward, frames 102-105)
